title: FOMC decision (meeting Sep 14-15, with SEP) — thirteen days before the September 2027 Consumer Confidence print, and inside its survey panel
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 166,936 bytes) and re-parsed panel-by-panel. The 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*" under the page's own footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections" -- so September 14-15 DOES carry a SEP, unlike the July 27-28 meeting the sibling fomc-2027-07-28 entry records. Sep 14 2027 is a Tuesday and Sep 15 a Wednesday, consistent with the two-day convention, and this file is named by the decision day exactly as every other fomc-* entry in this calendar. The parse was assertion-checked before anything downstream was trusted, using the traps two sibling ledgers banked: expanding the abbreviated cross-month labels AND consuming them before the full-month pattern runs (without which `Apr/May 30-1` self-matches as `May 30-1` and adds a phantom 2024 meeting) returns 56 meetings, exactly 8 in each of the seven years 2021-2027, and 17 CB-day collisions in the tape window -- all three assertions the siblings recorded. BYTE-COUNT DISCREPANCY, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: five sibling ledgers record this page at 164,831 bytes fetched on this same date, 2026-09-06; this session got 166,936. The 2027 panel text and the page's own "Last Update: August 19, 2026" stamp are identical, so the difference is elsewhere on the page, but the chain should stop describing this fetch as byte-identical. Filed estimate not for want of a primary but because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- the confirming venue is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting. The 14:00 ET statement time is the standing convention and is not on this page. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and proposed because a structural finding in that ledger has no home without it. THE SEPTEMBER FOMC HAS DRIFTED EARLIER EVERY YEAR AND IT HAS CHANGED WHAT THE SEPTEMBER CB PRINT IS. Decision days 2021-2027 run 09-22, 09-21, 09-20, 09-18, 09-17, 09-16, 09-15 -- monotone, never once later than the year before -- while the Conference Board print stays pinned to the last Tuesday. The gap was D+6 in 2021 through 2024 and is D+13 in 2025, 2026 and 2027. Under the roughly 16-day survey field window the CB editions' own stated cut-offs imply, that flip moves this decision from OUTSIDE the CB panel to INSIDE it: the 2027 panel runs about 09-05 to 09-21 and now contains both the decision and its SEP. FOUR THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) It is one of only four 2027 meetings carrying a SEP (Mar 16-17, Jun 8-9, Sep 14-15, Dec 7-8), and in 2027 those four are exactly the meetings whose decision lands inside a CB survey panel -- a coincidence of two calendars worth checking rather than assuming stable. (2) The blackout is proposed alongside it as fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04, derived from the Board's own stated ten-days-earlier rule. (3) The minutes are NOT proposed here: the Board's three-week convention, verified 42 of 45 by the fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 lane, puts them on Wednesday 2027-10-06, and that is this meeting's lane to file rather than a CB lane's to guess. (4) The CB lane already MEASURED the transmission question and found nothing: splitting all 51 clean CB days by whether a decision fell inside the print's field window gives 16 heard vs 35 deaf and 0 of 9 across nine instruments (smallest p AAPL 0.0604), so a rates lane should not inherit an assumption the equity tape refuses. Same channel caveat as every rate entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
